hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if [ ! -f tools/pending_wiki.py ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"wiki hook: tools/ not found, page NOT regenerated"}'; exit 0; fi; python tools/obsidian_sync.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage":"wiki hook: obsidian_sync.py FAILED"}'; python tools/pending_wiki.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage":"wiki hook: pending_wiki.py FAILED"}'; python tools/voice_guide.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage":"wiki hook: voice_guide.py FAILED - a voice tool is missing user-facing copy"}'; python tools/decision_debt.py --quiet || echo '{"systemMessage":"decision debt: a resolved decision has no build ticket - run python tools/decision_debt.py"}'; python tools/devlog.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage":"wiki hook: devlog.py FAILED"}'; git add -- docs/devlog.html docs/index.html docs/board.json docs/voice.html README.md docs/adr/adr-index.md vault/Board.md '.scratch/*/map.md' '.scratch/*/issues/*.md' >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Regenerating the pending wiki and board
